coming.name: Singita Elela
coming.note: Singita's first Botswana lodge: eight raised camps on a 170,000-hectare private concession in the western Okavango, on the former Abu Camp site. Opens 11 December 2026.
coming.tagline: Singita's first Botswana lodge: eight raised camps in the western Okavango Delta
coming.airport: Maun Airport (MUB), then Elela's own airstrip

coming.name: andBeyond Xaranna Okavango Delta Lodge
coming.note: andBeyond is rebuilding Xaranna Okavango Delta Camp as andBeyond Xaranna Okavango Delta Lodge, reopening August 2027.
